orders.label: Follow
orders.meaning: Guard the commander; keep support behind the frontline.

orders.label: Attack
orders.meaning: Advance and engage nearby threats, or focus a selected enemy.

orders.label: Hold
orders.meaning: Defend the chosen anchor; pursue only within ten blocks.

orders.label: Charge
orders.meaning: Commit to a selected enemy with reduced cohesion.

orders.label: Retreat
orders.meaning: Disengage to the destination; ignore enemies and interrupt prior attacks.

formations.label: Compact
formations.purpose: Narrow frontage; infantry screen the rear.

formations.label: Line
formations.purpose: Wide firing frontage; needs open ground.

formations.label: Shieldwall
formations.purpose: Wide shield front; shield troops brace when enemies close.

Ground-level review of gatehouse, hamlet and ridge shrine; distinct crossings.
Groups, ownership, contested state, destinations, teammate pings and feedback.

maps.name: Rivergate Valley
maps.description: A working river town: mill, farms, trade crossing and hilltop shrine.

maps.name: Ironhold Siege
maps.description: A breached border fortress: supply yards, gate roads and exposed flanks.

maps.name: Frostmarch Pass
maps.description: A mountain trade pass: sheltered camps, ridge routes and a frozen gorge.

maps.name: Hollowwood Reach
maps.description: An abandoned woodland road: old logging camps, shrines and marsh crossings.

maps.name: Kingsfield Crossroads
maps.description: Five objectives: two fords, a central bridge and a raised outpost on each flank.

classes.name: Champion
classes.bonus: +4 max health for you; your infantry within 10 blocks deal 10% more damage.
classes.activeText: Your troops within 12 cannot rout and take 25% less damage for 8 s; you gain Resistance I.
classes.passiveText: +4 max health for you; your infantry within 10 blocks deal 10% more damage.

classes.name: Reaver
classes.bonus: +2 attack damage for you; you respawn in 9 s instead of 12.
classes.activeText: Speed II and 30% lifesteal for 10 s; each troop you kill returns a fallen one, up to 3.
classes.passiveText: +2 attack damage for you; you respawn in 9 s instead of 12.

classes.name: Warden
classes.bonus: Your ranged troops deal 10% more damage and reach 2 blocks further.
classes.activeText: Mark a foe within 40 blocks: it glows and takes 30% more damage from your side for 12 s.
classes.passiveText: Your ranged troops deal 10% more damage and reach 2 blocks further.

classes.name: Marshal
classes.bonus: Your troops train in 20% less time.
classes.activeText: Routing groups rally and every group marches to you: 20 s steadier, 10% faster for 15 s.
classes.passiveText: Your troops train in 20% less time.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.bonus: Your magic troops cost 20% less gold in battle.
classes.activeText: Up to 6 troops that fell within 8 blocks in the last 20 s rise as your Risen for 30 s.
classes.passiveText: Your magic troops cost 20% less gold in battle.

classes.name: Quartermaster
classes.bonus: Each point you hold pays 2 more gold every income tick: 5 instead of 3.
classes.activeText: Plant a 40-health supply banner 30+ from base: troops deploy there for 60 s while safe.
classes.passiveText: Each point you hold pays 2 more gold every income tick: 5 instead of 3.

campaignBattles.name: The Training Field
campaignBattles.briefing: Dusk raiders hold the river road. Take the crossings and teach your banner to follow you.
campaignBattles.reason: The road west must open before the march begins.
